GHSA-7wqf-h36w-47mc.rationale: This advisory describes an OS Command Injection vulnerability in the Apache Airflow Pinot Provider affecting all Apache Airflow versions prior to 2.3.0, fixed in 2.3.0. The package under review is airflow-with-github_enterprise at version 2.10.5, which is a conda-forge metapackage that installs apache-airflow with GitHub Enterprise extras — it does not bundle the Pinot Provider. The OSV range covers introduced=0, fixed=2.3.0, and the latest conda version (2.10.5) is well beyond the fixed boundary. The affected_versions list in the match (all <=2.2.5) correctly excludes the current conda version, and affects_future is False. Because the vulnerability is in the Pinot Provider (a separately installed optional component) and the conda package under review is the github_enterprise variant which would not include apache-airflow-providers-pinot, runtime applicability is extremely limited even for historical versions. Nonetheless, historical conda builds of apache-airflow prior to 2.3.0 that also had the Pinot provider installed would have been vulnerable, but the current package version is not affected.
GHSA-7wqf-h36w-47mc.openvex_action_statement: Upgrade to airflow-with-github_enterprise >= 2.3.0. The current latest conda-forge version (2.10.5) is well beyond the fixed boundary of 2.3.0. Historical conda builds of apache-airflow < 2.3.0 with the Pinot Provider installed remain vulnerable; users should ensure they are running a current version.
